title: Enchanting Tutorial
description: Farengar Secret-Fire in Dragonsreach teaches the basics of enchanting. Learn enchantments by disenchanting items, use filled soul gems, and enchant at the Arcane Enchanter to complete the tutorial.

base_facts: I am the court wizard of Whiterun, stationed at my research quarters in Dragonsreach.
I sell soul gems, enchanted items, and other supplies needed for enchanting.

ASK_ABOUT_ENCHANTING: I explained the basics of enchanting: learn enchantments by disenchanting enchanted items at the Arcane Enchanter, then use a filled soul gem and the enchanter to apply the enchantment to another item.
Disenchanting destroys the source item, so I warned the student to be careful.
I have soul gems and other supplies for sale if the student needs them.

beats.comment: Player asks Farengar how to enchant weapons and armor; he explains the basics and the quest objective is set.
Quest completes when the player activates the Arcane Enchanter in Dragonsreach. No enchanting or disenchanting is required.
